views.title: Flow overlay
views.description: Image with one motion arrow per grid cell; arrow length and color follow the flow magnitude.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Frame to draw under the arrows (gray, or 3/4 channels in colorOrder)

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.description: (dx, dy) per cell in px/frame: a coarse grid, or a dense flow field (averaged down)

scale.description: Arrow length in screen px per px/frame of motion

colorMax.description: Magnitude (px/frame) with the hottest color; 0 = auto

dim.description: Darken (or lighten) the image toward the background, 0-1

spacing.description: Arrow spacing in px when a dense field is averaged down
